description: Demedici — Colore: Yellow & white texture Codice: 5220 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 142 cm Rapporto: 68.5 cm × 85 cm Toni: Yellow The Medici family’s wealth and influence, which began in textiles and grew from banking to the papacy, reached far beyond Italian borders and even further beyond the time of their reign. Patrons of some of the world’s greatest artists, especially from the Florentine Renaissance, DE MEDICI glorifies the family’s love of both beauty and power with dramatic ornamentation and large, stylized floral medallions.
